mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, u.reg_time AS regTime, r.rank_name AS rankName FROM salesman_customer sc INNER JOIN user u ON sc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_rank r ON u.rank_id = r.rank_id WHERE sc.salesman_id = #{filter.salesmanId} ORDER BY u.reg_time DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name AS rankName, sc.add_time AS bindTime, CASE WHEN ds.salesman_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'salesman' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) > 0 THEN 'ordered' ELSE 'customer' END AS customerType, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(o.paid_amount, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rl.refund_amount) FROM refund_log rl WHERE rl.order_id = o.order_id), 0), 0)), 0) AS orderAmount, MAX(o.pay_time) AS lastOrderTime, COALESCE(sc.channel, '') AS channel, COALESCE(sc.remark, '') AS remark FROM salesman_customer sc INNER JOIN `user` u ON sc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_rank r ON u.rank_id = r.rank_id LEFT JOIN salesman ds ON ds.user_id = sc.user_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.user_id = sc.user_id AND o.pay_status = 2 AND o.shop_id = #{filter.shopId} WHERE sc.salesman_id = #{filter.salesmanId}
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%') OR u.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.keyword}, '%'))
AND sc.add_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{filter.startTime}, ' 00:00:00'))
AND sc.add_time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{filter.endTime}, ' 23:59:59'))
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name, sc.add_time, sc.channel, sc.remark, ds.salesman_id
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) > 0
AND MAX(o.pay_time) >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{filter.startTime}, ' 00:00:00'))
AND MAX(o.pay_time) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{filter.endTime}, ' 23:59:59'))
HAVING ds.salesman_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc.add_time DESC, u.user_id DESC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name AS rankName, sc.add_time AS bindTime, CASE WHEN ds.salesman_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'salesman' WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) > 0 THEN 'ordered' ELSE 'customer' END AS customerType, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(o.paid_amount, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rl.refund_amount) FROM refund_log rl WHERE rl.order_id = o.order_id), 0), 0)), 0) AS orderAmount, MAX(o.pay_time) AS lastOrderTime, COALESCE(sc.channel, '') AS channel, COALESCE(sc.remark, '') AS remark FROM salesman_customer sc INNER JOIN `user` u ON sc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_rank r ON u.rank_id = r.rank_id LEFT JOIN salesman ds ON ds.user_id = sc.user_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.user_id = sc.user_id AND o.pay_status = 2 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.pay_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00')) AND o.pay_time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) WHERE sc.salesman_id = #{salesmanId} AND sc.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name, sc.add_time, sc.channel, sc.remark, ds.salesman_id

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name AS rankName, s.add_time AS bindTime, 'salesman' AS customerType, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aftersales a WHERE a.order_id = o.order_id) THEN o.order_id END) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(o.paid_amount, 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rl.refund_amount) FROM refund_log rl WHERE rl.order_id = o.order_id), 0), 0)), 0) AS orderAmount, MAX(o.pay_time) AS lastOrderTime, COALESCE(sc.channel, '') AS channel, COALESCE(sc.remark, '') AS remark FROM salesman s INNER JOIN `user` u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_rank r ON u.rank_id = r.rank_id LEFT JOIN salesman_customer sc ON sc.salesman_id = s.pid AND sc.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.user_id = s.user_id AND o.pay_status = 2 AND o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.pay_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00')) AND o.pay_time <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')) WHERE s.pid = #{salesmanId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.avatar, u.username, u.mobile, u.nickname, r.rank_name, s.add_time, sc.channel, sc.remark
